entry: Actual labuser browser via Computer/Browser; wizard disabled; native questions answered from private bakery facts
opening: I run a small bakery. Can you make a page so I know which orders need attention?
interaction_checks: Clarify undefined attention rule before implementation; use one short exchange when sufficient
Give a visible useful recommendation with a reason before implementation
State material sample-data/storage assumptions before implementation
No required scope-approval or technology/expertise questionnaire
Describe preview versus checks actually performed honestly
Explore existing prepared and relevant attendee data before creating rows; reuse a fit or give a specific fallback reason
independent_app_checks: Create or use a realistic order
Mark the order packed and verify resulting state after reload
Display a valid due date without Invalid Date
Reach primary action at desktop and 390px width
Phone status and action visible without horizontal scrolling in the first preview
Sample provenance and any reset limit labeled on the page
raw_journey_rubric: R01 runner retains historical scope-agreement assessment; it is observation only and not the R02 interaction verdict.
claim_limits: Single representative Claude bakery build and native Codex transport/control checks; all-harness fleet qualification remains pending
Actual CT integration remains separate; CT mutations forbidden
R02 acceptance is distinct from the broader R01/release restart/fault/calibrated-UX suite
operator_transport_checks: Codex reaches native prompt, asks one known question, receives ordinary terminal answer and acknowledges it
clear_request_control: Make a welcome page that says 'Hello, workshop!' and explains that this is a demo. It doesn't need data or buttons.
collector_policy: Record independently; missing collector messages cannot block a question visible in the real browser
